- UMass Boston now offers free e-bike and e-scooter charging at the West Garage Secured Shelter with 13 Saris Power Posts; simply register your bike through Project 529 for Beaconcard access. Learn more about bike parking and facilities . ## MBTA
Conveniently located just a mile from JFK/UMass Station, UMass Boston is easily accessible by public transportation. The campus is served by the Red Line, as well as the Greenbush , Kingston , and Middleborough/Lakeville commuter rail lines. Additionally, Route 8 operates daily from Kenmore Square, and Route 16 is available during peak commuting hours from Forest Hills. ## CLOSED | Spring 2026 Semester Pass Information
Spring Semester pass sales ended January 9, 2026. If you purchased a pass, find pickup and validity information below. If you missed the deadline, see "Need a Pass Now?" section below. Distribution Method: Spring 2026 MBTA Semester Passes will be available for pickup on campus beginning Monday, January 26. Students will receive an email with pickup instructions the week of January 19. Pass Validity Period: Spring MBTA semester passes are valid from February 1 to May 31, 2026. Plan Your Commute: Plan your commute using the MBTA Trip Planner . Pricing Information: View MBTA Semester Pass Pricing Information . Link and Bus Passes: Link, Local, and Express bus passes are issued via CharlieCards once per semester. Link and bus passes can be replaced if lost. Zone and Boat Passes: Zone and Boat passes are issued monthly on CharlieTickets. All passes are included in the total semester pass cost. Zone and Boat passes cannot be replaced. Refund Policy : MBTA passes are non-refundable and non-exchangeable, so make your purchase decision carefully. Payment Process: The semester pass cost will be added automatically to your Spring term bill. Cash, personal checks, or debit/credit cards are not accepted. Liability: The university is not liable for lost or damaged passes and cannot replace commuter rail or boat passes. Subsidy for Undergraduate Students: A $20 nonrefundable fee on undergraduate term bills provides discounts for eligible undergraduate students. STATUS (as of December 26, 2025): The 50% subsidy was fully allocated. Undergraduate students purchasing later in the sales window received an 11% discount. For subsidy inquiries, contact studentgovernment @umb.edu . Spring Semester pass sales ended January 9, 2026.

Pre-Tax Parking & Transit | Commute Smarter, Save More | Transit and (Offsite) Parking FSA | ## Commute Smarter, Save More
All university parking permits must be purchased using the Parking Portal . The portal may also be used to update your vehicle information and cancel your parking permit. Log in to the portal with your UMass Boston credentials. The UMass Boston Office of Transportation Services is here to help you access our campus, whether you are coming by car, bus, bike, or foot. Transportation Services is committed to providing safe and affordable multi-modal transportation options to all our community members to reduce traffic congestion and single occupancy vehicles (SOV) on campus, and to improve air pollution. Use the interactive campus map to find food, vending machines, and other amenities. You can also print our transportation map or find campus buildings on our mobile app
Enrollment Election

## Transit and (Offsite) Parking FSA
Through the Qualified Transportation Benefits Program (QTBP), you are eligible for a pre-tax benefit program that includes both offsite parking and transit related expenses. QTBP is administered by Voya and allows you to have transit and/or offsite parking expenses deducted from your paycheck on a pre-tax basis. Pre-tax limits and reimbursement eligibility are subject to the IRS’s rules and regulations How To Enroll : Employees need to enroll directly through VOYA . If you want to participate in both the Transit and Parking programs you must make elections in each benefit’s section on the election form. How to Change Your Election : You may change or opt out of the program at any point during the plan year. To modify your participation in the plan, you simply access the enrollment form. Once you submit the form, a copy of the request will be sent to Voya and a copy is also sent to your division’s appointed payroll contact, whom will make the necessary updates to payroll to reflect your requested change. *If you are looking for information regarding on-site parking, please visit Umass Boston Transportation Services . - UMass Boston now offers free e-bike and e-scooter charging at the West Garage Secured Shelter with 13 Saris Power Posts; simply register your bike through Project 529 for Beaconcard access. Learn more about bike parking and facilities . ## About Biking at UMass Boston
UMass Boston supports cycling as a sustainable transportation option by offering parking , free registration, end-of-trip amenities , and access to the Bluebikes bikeshare program. Whether you bring your own bike or use bikeshare, we provide resources to ensure safe, efficient, and convenient travel on campus. ## How to Park & Register Your Bike

## Where to Park Your Bike (Free & Secure!)
UMass Boston offers over 740 free bike parking spaces campus-wide, including: West Garage Secured Shelter: 125-space indoor, secure bike storage Maintenance Station: Basic maintenance tools are available inside the West Garage Charging Stations (West Garage Bike Shelter Only): 13 Saris Power Posts with 26 ports for e-bikes and e-scooters (free to use with certified batteries). Lock your rear wheel and frame to the ring with a U-lock, then plug in your personal charger. Move your device to another rack once fully charged To use the West Garage secure shelter, you must first register your bicycle through Project 529 . Once your registration is confirmed, you’ll receive access to the shelter using your Beaconcard. Full registration details and instructions are available in Register Your Bike, E-Bike, Scooter, or E-Scooter . ## Register Your Bike, E-Bike, Scooter, or E-Scooter
All bikes, e-bikes, scooters, and e-scooters, can be registered through Project 529. Registration is free, quick, and helps protect your device. Registration is required to access the secure shelter in the West Garage, and strongly encouraged for all riders to support theft prevention and recovery. Why Register? Registration acts as a deterrent against theft when used with the optional 529 Shield. Registration helps staff and law enforcement return lost or stolen devices. Registration is required for access to the secured, indoor bike parking area in the West Garage. E-Bike & E-Scooter Requirements Devices with electric motors must have batteries certified by UL, TUV, or another Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratory (NRTL). Devices without certified batteries are not eligible for secure shelter access. If certification is missing, Transportation Services will follow up to request additional details. How to Register Use the UMass Boston 529 Registration Page or download the Project 529 app . Sign up with your UMass Boston email address. Enter your device’s make, model, color, and serial number (usually near the crank or rear wheel). Select "UMass Boston" as your organization. Submit your registration. What Happens Next Transportation Services will review your registration. You’ll receive an email when your Beaconcard has been activated for indoor, secure shelter access in the West Garage. After access is confirmed, you may request a free 529 Shield. If requested, we’ll assign it to your registration and notify you when it’s ready for pickup in our office. What Is a 529 Shield? A tamper-resistant, weatherproof sticker that links your physical device to your 529 Garage registration. It supports theft deterrence and helps with recovery. The 529 Shield is optional but strongly recommended. All bikes, e-bikes, scooters, and e-scooters, can be registered through Project 529. Registration is free, quick, and helps protect your device.
